thesis: The site is a hex-mosaic floor laid across Chicago: every section is one tile in the pattern, and scrolling walks you through the rooms and seasons where tile lives in these houses.

signature.name: Hex Mosaic Map
signature.summary: A field of small flat-topped hexagons in brick/cream/green that fills via --sw-p as you scroll; the same hex clips every photo, marks list items, frames reviews and completes in the footer. Hook: data-sw-signature='hex-map'.

motion.intro: Hex mask scales from small tile to full hero photo in ≤1s, then h1 line-mask reveals.
stories: Hex area map fills tile-by-tile through four season bands (pinned ≥640px, stacked cards below).
motion.hover: Hairline grows scaleX(0→1) from left, 200ms, hover:hover only.
